cases.action: Lose close reply then retry public openRun --new

cases.action: Lose launch reply, positively observe replacement on --new retry
cases.expected: Same attempt becomes launched; same pane; one launch and archive

cases.action: Lose launch reply and remove replacement tab/pane, then retry --new

cases.action: Hold first close while second openRun --new competes
cases.expected: Second refuses; one replacement and launch

cases.action: SIGKILL child public openRun at durable closeRequested; retry from another process
cases.expected: Pending attempt survives; retry inspects and rolls back an owned usable original or safely completes same attempt after confirmed closure; unavailable inspection is retryable; no duplicate native session

cases.action: Retry --new after intent
cases.expected: Roll back to verified usable original, keep archive custody, terminal rolledBack; no close or launch

cases.action: Retry --new before dispatch
cases.expected: Verify prepared ownership and empty pane; dispatch same prepared native identity once; one archive

cases.action: Use approve, done, ask, changes, evidence or cancel while replacement pending
cases.expected: Legacy command semantics; no pending or replacement-lock refusal; cancel closes chats and remains cancelled

cases.action: Read status during slow gh or Herdr inspection while done records progress
cases.expected: Status holds no replacement lock during external calls; done does not fail busy; status names pending phase and pdd workflow open ISSUE --new

cases.action: Refuse --new eligibility or ownership before intent
cases.expected: Entire saved run unchanged including state and chatFailure; no native effect

cases.action: Herdr pane run returns nonempty JSON without throwing
cases.expected: Launch succeeds with same replacement; phase launched; one dispatch

cases.action: Cancel after replacement checkpoint and before next effect
cases.expected: Replacement stops; no later checkpoint restores running or overwrites cancellation

cases.action: Advance run.area through legacy approve/done while replacement is pending; resolve with open ISSUE --new, then separately replace the current area
cases.expected: Saved attempt remains valid; recovery only rolls back a verified usable original or safely ends the historical attempt, never launching a fresh native session for the old area; newer area/chat/state/gate/question and progress stay unchanged; terminal history permits a later separate current-area replacement

cases.action: Lose exact-session recovery resume reply at intent/closeRequested rollback or launchRequested stopped replacement; retry before and after observing that same agent
cases.expected: Wait START_GRACE_MS before resuming an unconfirmed replacement; persist resumeRequested before any allowed dispatch for the same original/current replacement target; no repeated resume while observation is absent/unavailable; positive same-session observation finishes the existing attempt without a new identity

cases.action: Lose close acknowledgement, advance with done/approve, then retry --new with saved original session evidence
cases.expected: Roll back or safely end the same old-area attempt; zero fresh dispatches, unchanged newer current chat and progress

cases.action: Pause ordinary open after run selection while its ended session would resume; request --new concurrently
cases.expected: Competing --new refuses in plain words while plain open owns the same run lock; only one live recorded agent

cases.action: Lose launch reply, hide starting agent but expose exact session file, retry within START_GRACE_MS
cases.expected: No resume or fresh dispatch; retryable same --new advice; after grace the exact saved-session recovery may proceed

cases.action: Return pane_not_found for exact original/replacement agent inspection
cases.expected: Count as missing only if complete inventory also proves pane absent; present or ambiguous inventory refuses without launch

cases.action: Read detailed status with closeRequested pending
cases.expected: Both State and Next name the phase and pdd workflow open ISSUE --new; status holds no run lock during external calls

cases.action: Replace or recover a uniquely owned allocation
cases.expected: Visible tab label is exactly the area name, no UUID; inventory custody distinguishes the attempt

cases.action: Cancel immediately before final launchRequested checkpoint
cases.expected: Final cancellation reread stops dispatch and never restores running; cancellation after this check is a documented non-atomic legacy boundary

cases.action: Keep one plain open attached; invoke a second plain open, then --new
cases.expected: Both later opens proceed; read/allocation/resume/save stays serialized before attach; the first attachment does not hold the run lock

cases.action: Lose launch request before dispatch; retry --new at START_GRACE_MS with exact owned live pane and authoritative shell-only process-info
cases.expected: Record proof and once-only recovery dispatch intent before sending same prepared launch once; retain native identity and one archive; status explains retry

cases.action: Retry lost launch after START_GRACE_MS with Codex/Claude process present but no native UUID
cases.expected: No second launch or blind resume; retain same custody for observation

cases.action: Retry lost launch after START_GRACE_MS with missing, malformed or unknown process-info
cases.expected: No fresh dispatch or tab closure; safe pending retains identity and names --new plus cancel

cases.action: Advance current area after prepared but never requested launch; recover with verified owned shell-only pane
cases.expected: Close only historical empty owned tab and end attempt; no fresh launch, unchanged newer current chat and progress; unknown or agent process never authorizes close

cases.action: Prove unsent launch after grace, save recovery dispatch intent, lose recovery launch reply, retry --new
cases.expected: No repeated recovery dispatch based on the earlier proof; positive same-agent observation may finish same attempt. Another dispatch requires fresh START_GRACE_MS and authoritative process proof that the latest request never ran
